front: Je me réveille à six heures et demie.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh ray-VAY ah see zuhr ay duh-MEE]
back: I wake up at half past six.
context: 'Se réveiller' = to wake up. Reflexive verbs need the pronoun: je me, tu te, il se, nous nous, vous vous, ils se.

front: Je me lève tout de suite.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh LEV toot SWEET]
back: I get up right away.
context: 'Se lever' = to get up. 'Tout de suite' = right away.

front: Je me douche et je m'habille.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh DOOSH ay zhuh mah-BEE]
back: I shower and get dressed.
context: Me → m' before a vowel: je m'habille.

front: Il se brosse les dents après le petit-déjeuner.
pronunciation: [eel suh bros lay DAHN ah-preh luh puh-tee day-zhuh-NAY]
back: He brushes his teeth after breakfast.
context: With body parts, use the reflexive + 'les': se brosser les dents (not 'ses dents').

front: Elle se maquille dans la salle de bain.
pronunciation: [el suh mah-KEE dahn lah sal duh BAN]
back: She does her makeup in the bathroom.
context: 'Se maquiller' = to put on makeup. 'Se raser' = to shave.

front: Je prends mon petit-déjeuner vers sept heures.
pronunciation: [zhuh prahn mohn puh-tee day-zhuh-NAY vehr seh TUHR]
back: I have breakfast around seven.
context: 'Prendre son petit-déjeuner' = to have breakfast.

front: Je pars de chez moi à huit heures.
pronunciation: [zhuh par duh shay MWAH ah wee TUHR]
back: I leave home at eight.
context: 'Partir de' = to leave from.

front: Je mets une demi-heure pour aller au travail.
pronunciation: [zhuh meh tün duh-mee-UHR poor ah-lay oh trah-VAHY]
back: It takes me half an hour to get to work.
context: 'Mettre' + time = to take (time) to do something.

front: Le midi, je déjeune avec mes collègues.
pronunciation: [luh mee-DEE, zhuh day-zhuhn ah-vek may koh-LEG]
back: At lunchtime, I have lunch with my colleagues.
context: 'Déjeuner' = to have lunch (in France).

front: L'après-midi, je suis souvent en réunion.
pronunciation: [lah-preh-mee-DEE, zhuh swee soo-vahn tahn ray-ü-NYOHN]
back: In the afternoon, I'm often in meetings.
context: 'L'après-midi' can be masculine or feminine.

front: Je rentre vers dix-huit heures trente.
pronunciation: [zhuh rahn-truh vehr dee-zwee tuhr TRAHNT]
back: I get home around 6:30 p.m.
context: 'Rentrer' = to come back home.

front: Je fais les courses en rentrant du travail.
pronunciation: [zhuh feh lay KOORS ahn rahn-trahn dü trah-VAHY]
back: I do the shopping on my way home from work.
context: Gérondif 'en rentrant' = while/on the way coming home.

front: On dîne vers vingt heures.
pronunciation: [ohn deen vehr van TUHR]
back: We have dinner around 8 p.m.
context: French families often eat dinner together around 7:30–8:30 p.m.

front: Après le dîner, je me repose devant la télé.
pronunciation: [ah-preh luh dee-NAY, zhuh muh ruh-pohz duh-vahn lah tay-LAY]
back: After dinner, I relax in front of the TV.
context: 'Se reposer' = to rest.

front: Je me couche vers vingt-trois heures.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh koosh vehr vant-trwah ZUHR]
back: I go to bed around 11 p.m.
context: 'Se coucher' = to go to bed; 's'endormir' = to fall asleep.

front: Je m'endors très vite.
pronunciation: [zhuh mahn-dor treh VEET]
back: I fall asleep very quickly.
context: 'S'endormir' conjugates like dormir: je m'endors.

front: Tu te couches tard, toi !
pronunciation: [tü tuh koosh TAR, TWAH]
back: You go to bed late!
context: Stressed pronoun 'toi' at the end adds emphasis.

front: Nous nous promenons le dimanche matin.
pronunciation: [noo noo proh-muh-NOHN luh dee-mahnsh mah-TAN]
back: We go for a walk on Sunday mornings.
context: 'Se promener' = to go for a walk. Note the double 'nous'.

front: Vous vous entendez bien avec vos voisins ?
pronunciation: [voo voo zahn-tahn-day BYAN ah-vek voh vwah-ZAN]
back: Do you get along well with your neighbors?
context: 'S'entendre avec' = to get along with.

front: Ils s'occupent des enfants le mercredi.
pronunciation: [eel soh-KÜP day zahn-FAHN luh mehr-kruh-DEE]
back: They look after the children on Wednesdays.
context: 'S'occuper de' = to take care of.

front: Je m'habille vite le matin.
pronunciation: [zhuh mah-beey VEET luh mah-TAN]
back: I get dressed quickly in the morning.
context: Reflexive: s'habiller. Without the reflexive, 'habiller quelqu'un' = to dress someone else.

front: Je ne me lève jamais avant sept heures le week-end.
pronunciation: [zhuh nuh muh lev zhah-meh ah-vahn seh TUHR luh wee-KEND]
back: I never get up before seven at weekends.
context: Negation wraps pronoun + verb: je ne me lève pas.

front: D'abord je prends un café, ensuite je lis mes mails.
pronunciation: [dah-BOR zhuh prahn an kah-FAY, ahn-sweet zhuh lee may MEL]
back: First I have a coffee, then I read my emails.
context: Sequence words: d'abord, ensuite, puis, après, enfin.

front: Enfin, je me mets au travail.
pronunciation: [ahn-FAN, zhuh muh meh oh trah-VAHY]
back: Finally, I get down to work.
context: 'Se mettre à' = to start, get down to.

front: Tous les jours, c'est la même routine.
pronunciation: [too lay ZHOOR, seh lah mem roo-TEEN]
back: Every day, it's the same routine.
context: 'Tous les jours' = every day; 'toujours' = always.

front: Le mardi, je vais à la piscine.
pronunciation: [luh mar-DEE, zhuh veh ah lah pee-SEEN]
back: On Tuesdays, I go to the swimming pool.
context: 'Le' + day = every (Tuesday).

front: Je fais le ménage le samedi matin.
pronunciation: [zhuh feh luh may-NAHZH luh sahm-dee mah-TAN]
back: I do the housework on Saturday mornings.
context: 'Faire le ménage' = to clean the house; 'faire la lessive' = to do the laundry.

front: Je me suis réveillé en retard ce matin.
pronunciation: [zhuh muh swee ray-veh-YAY ahn ruh-TAR suh mah-TAN]
back: I woke up late this morning.
context: Reflexive verbs use être in the passé composé.

front: Elle s'est endormie devant le film.
pronunciation: [el seh tahn-dor-MEE duh-vahn luh FEELM]
back: She fell asleep during the film.
context: Agreement: s'est endormie (+e) for a woman.

front: Couche-toi, il est tard !
pronunciation: [koosh-TWAH, ee leh TAR]
back: Go to bed, it's late!
context: Reflexive imperative: couche-toi, lève-toi, dépêche-toi.
